kind: Optimization implementation and physical Windows x64 validation; different versions are kept separate
retained_changes: Concurrency-aware per-request stage budgets in a shared fixed-size CPU pool
Non-fused SIMD spatial tails for NCHW pad-end 2x2 convolution
Prevalidated NCHW OC4 pointwise reduction separated from fused stores
NHWC depthwise interior row reductions separated from borders and output transforms
rejected_experiments: NHWC recognition pointwise K=256 cache blocking: six correctness tests passed but neither backbone diagnostic improved; removed
build_tuning_decision: Thin LTO with one codegen unit is documented as an optional consuming-application release setting. Exact outputs matched both diagnostic cases; the medium case improved with non-overlapping samples, while the small case overlapped. Cargo defaults and official C# qualification remain unchanged.

checks.cargo_clippy_all_targets: existing style lints in tools/baseline/mod.rs and tools/benchmark/mod.rs

limitations: The CPU-budget-only medium comparison overlapped a newly started unrelated build; its timing failure cannot isolate the budgeting change.
Kernel and instrumented backbone samples are diagnostics, not end-to-end OCR gates. The before/after samples are separate code versions and are not pooled.
C# pointwise/depthwise samples show substantial warm-up variability; keep raw ranges.
AVX-512 and non-x64 native execution were not available on this host.
The full 213-case qualification precedes equivalent lint-only changes; a rebuilt focused qualification and the final performance workers check the final source.
Stable line assignment and CLS/REC stage ordering remain unchanged; pipeline fusion was not validated.
All-target Clippy finds existing style lints in tools/baseline/mod.rs and tools/benchmark/mod.rs; library all-feature Clippy passes with warnings denied.
